verdict.rationale: First-party docs state plainly that Bruno is offline-only with no cloud sync, no account and no login, and that collections live as plain-text files in a folder on the local filesystem. Community users corroborate choosing Bruno specifically to avoid Postman's cloud-account requirement and to keep collections as local text files. Missing for 10: no hands-on report of an air-gapped or fully offline session confirming every feature works without network access.
